output_list.criticism: The function does not properly check for overflows, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to a very high value.
The function does not check for overflows, allowing a user to transfer a balance of tokens to another user, causing a denial of service.
The function does not check for overflows, allowing an attacker to cause a denial of service to the token owner if they are tricked into calling this function.
The function does not check for overflows, allowing the contract owner to cause a denial of service to any user if they are tricked into calling this function.
The function allows the owner to set any attacker contract as 'fights' address, potentially causing assets loss to token owners.
